headword: {不用品|ふようひん}{回収|かいしゅう}
reading: ふようひんかいしゅう

definitions.gloss: unwanted item collection; junk removal; disposal service
definitions.explanation: A service that collects and disposes of items people no longer need, such as old furniture, appliances, and household goods. Common in Japan, where strict waste disposal rules make getting rid of large items complicated.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{不用品|ふようひん}→不用品：03146_fuyouhin⟧ (unwanted items) and ⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧ (collection; recovery). In Japan, disposing of large items like furniture and appliances requires paying for ⟦{粗大|そだい}ゴミ→粗大ゴミ：08045_sodaigomi⟧ (bulky waste) pickup through the municipality, so private {不用品|ふようひん}{回収|かいしゅう} services are widely used.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Trucks playing recorded announcements offering free collection of unwanted items are a common sight in Japanese neighborhoods. While some are legitimate, others charge unexpected fees, so consumer warnings about such services are frequent in the news.
